content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I am unable to find the URL for the IP address of my [company_name] [product_name]. I cannot retrieve the IP or reset the [product_name]. Thank you.
Does your [product_name] have a display? If so, you can view it in the Network menu under IP address.
Hello [user_name], thanks for your response. I tried using the [product_name] to access this feature but received a 'network error' message. I hope the [product_name] is not damaged.

With the [product_name], you need to select the correct [product_name] for communication. Choose the device, press OK, then navigate with the RIGHT Cursor button to the small triangle. If the cursor is on the triangle, press OK. Select the appropriate device and press OK again.
I tried this process, but entering the last known IP address does not start the connection. It’s possible that the [product_name] software has changed the device’s IP address.

Create a simple program in [product_name] software, set the IP address, and export it to an SD card. Alternatively, save the program from a [product_name] with a display, where you can check the current IP address. This operation should store the device’s IP address on the SD card along with the program. Insert the card into the device and power it up; it will load the program and also set the IP address from the card.
I ran this test but it did not work. With the [product_name], I cannot send any commands to the device.
I found the solution—the issue was with the PC's network card. Thank you all for your help.

analysis.insight_summary: Users faced challenges retrieving or resetting the IP address of a [company_name] [product_name], causing failed connection attempts and uncertainty about whether the device or external hardware were responsible. Troubleshooting involved both device menu navigation and [product_name] software usage. Ultimately, the problem was identified as a malfunction with the PC's network card, showing that external hardware issues can impact device accessibility and user experience.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a straightforward way to retrieve or reset the IP address for the [company_name] [product_name], either through onboard features or connected peripherals, and reliable device access over the network.
